Es responsable de proporcionar apoyo en el desarrollo, implementación y seguimiento de las estrategias de mercadotecnia para el crecimiento del negocio en México y Centroamérica.

Analizar información de mercado, competencia y tendencias para generar insights que soporten la toma de decisiones comerciales y estratégicas.
Coordinar el desarrollo y actualización de materiales de marketing y ventas (presentaciones, folletos, argumentarios, herramientas digitales).

Licenciatura concluida en marketing, administración de empresas, ingeniería biomédica y/o carreras relacionadas al sector salud (titulado).

description:

As we implement our AI Transformation, our GTM and Adoption team helps turn digital investment into real impact by understanding and removing barriers, driving high-impact engagement, and ensuring the new digital platforms we launch become embedded into how our colleagues work.

This is a product marketing role. The products are internal AI platforms. The market is roughly 80,000 Pfizer colleagues around the world. Positioning, segmentation, launch, and demand generation all apply here, with adoption and retention as the scoreboard.

The craft at the center of the role is positioning: holding one argument per platform and telling it in many ways. A scientist in the lab, a supervisor on a manufacturing line, and an analyst in finance should each recognize their own work in the same value proposition, and a colleague who has never heard of a platform needs something different from one who tried it once and stopped. Working norms, language, and attitudes toward AI at work also differ across our markets and business lines, so messaging here is adapted for the audience rather than translated once and sent everywhere. What we are claiming stays constant. How it is told, to whom, and at what point in their journey is where this role does its work.

This role translates technical features into highly compelling, user-centric narratives, running internal product launches with the same rigor, creativity, and brand building typically reserved for external consumer technology launches. Most internal launch emails and mandatory announcements get ignored, and that's the bar this role is here to clear: before defaulting to the standard internal-comms playbook, this role tries something unconventional first, and builds campaigns around what actually earns attention rather than what's easiest to schedule.

Facilitate knowledge sharing through communication channels that connect colleagues with successful practices, lessons learned, and success stories.

We are looking for a creative, strategic, and results-driven Social Media Manager to lead and develop our social media presence across multiple platforms. Role Title: Product Marketing Reviewer (Remote)
Role Type: Contractor
Location: Remote




What We're Researching

We're running a paid study on go-to-market strategies tailored to independent retail operations. Specifically, we are evaluating a new appointment management tool designed for independent bicycle repair shops. This research helps us refine our initial product positioning and identify hidden risks before launch.




How It Works

You will complete an asynchronous, remote review of a short go-to-market brief. During this task, you will read through our target audience assumptions, proposed messaging, and launch plan. Next, you will write a short report that clearly separates unsubstantiated assumptions from hard evidence. Finally, you will recommend one low-cost validation step to test our riskiest assumption without conducting new market outreach.




Who This Is For

We welcome Product Marketing Managers, GTM Strategists, and early-stage Product Managers with experience in retail software or small business tools. Candidates should have a strong grasp of market validation techniques and startup strategy. Familiarity with independent bike shops or local service businesses is a strong plus, though not strictly required.




What You’ll Do

1. You will complete an asynchronous, remote review of a short go-to-market brief.

description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

Open Role: Graduate Partner Marketing Manager

Marketers at Canonical are brand stewards and demand creators.They transform complex open-source technology into messages, stories and strategies that shape the market understanding of our vision. Some focus on differentiated product and portfolio positioning; others specialize in account-based engagement, partner and alliance messaging, or product-led growth. Whatever their specialization, each marketer works as part of a cross-functional unit, contributing campaigns and insights that help the company learn and grow faster.

We have a bias for action, focus efforts on the most impactful activities and take ownership of our results. We work across long buying cycles, balance storytelling with data, design experiments, track outcomes, and iterate rapidly to find what works.

Marketers at Canonical don’t just promote open source; they amplify it, ensuring our innovations reach the right people, at the right time, with clarity and purpose from developers to decision makers.

As a Graduate Partner Marketing Manager, you aren’t just running campaigns; you are architecting the strategic relationships that drive our business forward. You will collaborate with the titans of tech:


Public cloud: AWS, Google, Microsoft, Oracle.
Silicon: NVIDIA, Intel, Arm, Qualcomm, AMD.
Global hardware: Dell, HP, Lenovo.



Early careers & growth

We are specifically looking for recent graduates who are serious about their success and ready to make a global impact. At Canonical, we prioritize talent and potential over years of experience; we will teach you the technical and commercial nuances of the open-source world through our structured career journey program. You will gain experience working with top tier talent and with multiple enterprise technologies. If you have the drive and a high standard for excellence, we provide the platform for you to become a world-class marketing leader.

Location: This role will be based remotely in the Americas region and will report to the Partner Marketing Team Manager.

Your impact


Architect joint success: Build high-velocity go-to-market plans with global partners, moving from initial messaging to full-scale pipeline generation.
Launch at scale: Lead integrated campaigns, industry announcements, and product launches that reach everyone from developers to C-suite decision-makers.
Creative packaging: Translate cutting-edge tech in the open-source world into educational and marketing content that resonates.
Ecosystem evolution: Shape and scale our partner programs to keep pace with an ever-expanding network of hardware vendors, software vendors, and channel resellers.



What We’re Looking For


The marketing basics: You understand how marketing works (especially within enterprises) and have familiarity with common marketing platforms, social media, and business technology.
The relationship builder: You can navigate complex and dynamic organizations and build lasting rapport.
The analytical thinker: You obsess over value and use data to decide which experiments to scale and which to iterate.
The self-starter: You thrive in a fast-paced, remote environment and aren't afraid to "roll up your sleeves" to get a project across the finish line.



What We Offer You

Your base pay will depend on various factors including your geographical location, level of experience, knowledge and skills. In addition to the benefits above, certain roles are also eligible for additional benefits and rewards including annual bonuses and sales incentives based on revenue or utilisation. Our compensation philosophy is to ensure equity right across our global workforce.

In addition to a competitive base pay, we provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. Please note that additional benefits may apply depending on the work location and, for more information on these, please ask your Talent Partner.


Fully remote working environment - we’ve been working remotely since 2004!
Personal learning and development budget of 2,000USD per annum
Annual compensation review
Recognition rewards
Annual holiday leave
Parental Leave
Employee Assistance Programme
Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues at ‘sprints’
Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events



About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do.

Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Work at Canonical is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical provides a unique window into the world of 21st-century digital business.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Life At WPP Media & Benefits

Our passion for shaping the next era of media is powered by our commitment to Be Extraordinary, investing in our employees to inspire transformational creativity. For Mexico

This position is available in a Remote or Hybrid Work Modality. The candidate must perform their work from any location within Mexico. Integrated program experience across events, ABM, digital, and partner channels, rather than isolated event logistics or lead-volume activity.

Hands-on Salesforce and HubSpot experience for campaign execution, follow-up workflows, and performance visibility.
Independent strategic planning and precise hands-on execution, including vendors, event delivery, and budget management.
Strong written and verbal communication and evidence of influencing Sales leaders without direct authority in a remote-first environment.
Practical ability to apply AI to field marketing workflows while checking output quality and protecting confidential and personal data.

Marketing into LATAM or Canada.

Intent platforms, direct mail tools, and event platforms.

About The Role

We’re looking for a creative, hands-on marketer to take ownership of Van Mart’s digital channels, content strategy, and day-to-day marketing execution. Van Mart sells DIY van parts and accessories. You will translate product benefits and customer needs into compelling content, coordinated campaigns, qualified leads, and ecommerce sales. This role combines strategic thinking with direct execution: developing ideas, managing social accounts, scheduling and publishing content, coordinating creative production, and optimizing performance. You will work closely with the Marketing Director, Ecommerce Director, CRM Growth Lead, and marketing team. This is an individual contributor position with ownership of marketing projects and creative production coordination.

description:
Job Description Summary

This role sets the standard for paid search across Global Markets and delivers it hands-on. Building on the strong foundation our zones and agencies have established, you will work with zone marketers, agencies, and corporate and segment teams to raise the quality and consistency of search marketing across our markets. For some zones you will design and run campaigns. For others you will guide the zone or its agency.

You will also partner closely with Corporate Marketing and business teams to run test-and-learn programs in answer engine optimization (AEO) and generative engine optimization (GEO).

Job Description

Core responsibilities


Search standards. Define and maintain global standards for paid search, including account structure, keyword and bidding approach, structured testing, campaign taxonomy, UTM and conversion tracking, and brief and intake requirements. Drive adoption across zones that use different delivery models.
Enablement. Train zone marketers and agencies on the standard, share best practices and run a search community of practice.
Hands-on execution. For campaigns you run, lead advanced keyword strategy, ad creation, bidding, structured A/B and multivariate testing, audience targeting and landing page optimization. Quality-check tracking and ad delivery.
Measurement. Define search performance reporting. Work with analytics teams to apply attribution models and track key performance indicators (KPIs), including click-through rate, conversion rate, cost per acquisition (CPA) and return on ad spend (ROAS). Present results clearly to stakeholders in and outside marketing.
Budget stewardship. Own and forecast central search budgets. Manage zone- and business-funded budgets for campaigns you run, and advise on those you guide. Track pacing and planned-versus-actual spend across budgets, and flag over- and underspend. Optimize for return on investment and scalability. Identify wasted spend through negative keyword and audience refinement, and reinvest the savings in higher-performing search.
AEO and GEO. Lead test-and-learn programs and document what you learn. You will influence, but not own, site and content decisions.
Multi-market delivery. Adapt search strategy across languages, currencies and regional platform behavior.
Collaboration. Work with Corporate Marketing (SEO and web), segment and product teams, and agencies to connect search to customer lifecycle programs. Coordinate with other digital channel teams, such as social, to support a multichannel approach.
Trendspotting. Track platform changes, AI capabilities in search and industry best practices, and bring them into the standard.
Additional responsibilities as assigned.


How You Will Work With Zones

Zones activate search in different ways: some locally, some through their own agencies. You will adapt to each zone's model, working in one of two modes agreed with the zone.


 Lead execution. You design, launch and optimize search campaigns for one or more zones, applying the global standard directly.
 Guide and support. The zone or its agency runs its own campaigns. You provide the standard, review, benchmarking and expert guidance.


In both modes, you are accountable for the search standard and for measuring performance against it.

Qualifications

Required


6–8 years in paid search, with at least 3 years in a strategy role (Mandatory)
Advanced English proficiency 
Bachelor's degree in marketing, business or a related field, or equivalent experience.
Evidence of leading adoption of AI-enabled bidding or campaign types on Google and Bing.
Advanced proficiency in Google Ads and GA4, and experience with an enterprise bid-management platform and an enterprise analytics or business intelligence tool.
Track record of improving cost per acquisition (CPA), return on ad spend (ROAS) or conversion quality, and of linking search to revenue outcomes.
Experience influencing senior stakeholders without formal authority.

Job Description

About us

With over 200 brands sold in nearly 180 countries, Diageo is home to some of the world’s most iconic drinks. From Johnnie Walker and Guinness to Tanqueray, Smirnoff and Don Julio, we craft brands chosen for life’s moments — from everyday connections to landmark celebrations.

Bring your talent, curiosity and ambition, and strive for your personal best alongside people who challenge, support and learn from each other. Together, as one outstanding team, we keep learning, improving and raising the bar for our brands, our business and each other.

Join us and play your part in making life’s moments mean a little more.

About The Function

Sales is where our brands meet the real world.

This team builds the relationships that bring our products to life, partnering closely with customers across markets, channels and occasions to make sure our brands are part of moments that matter everywhere.

It’s a dynamic, people-focused environment where curiosity, commercial thinking and strong relationships make the difference. You’ll have the opportunity to grow your network, develop your skills and see the direct impact of your work every day.

About The Role

The RGM Sr. Manager – Mexico is a key leadership role to drive the Growth discipline including RGM, commercial planning, customer planning, and performance management in Diageo Mexico.

Financial Accountability

Responsible for the strategic delivery of the full business top-line performance and Gross Margin targets.

Key Functional Responsibilities


Partner with the Regional/Global RGM team to grow capabilities and share best practices.
Co-lead the multifunctional RGM team being responsible for 100% of levers, Channels and Categories.
Lead the Strategic Pricing and Assortment agendas.
RGM Champion for Scotch & Modern Trade Channels.
Establish appropriate routines with Sales Channels to develop and deliver against the Promotional effectiveness & Trade Terms agenda.
Understand and enable market decisions based on trade-offs between market share, volume, sales, price, mix and profit.
Manage high level of Complexity – Ability to work across selling divisions, and multiple functions to educate and embed the revenue growth management discipline to their respective business units.


Key Leadership Responsibilities


Partner with Commercial Leaders to embed RGM & E2E Planning ways of thinking and processes into the local market, including Planning and Business Performance Management routines, grounded in an analytical approach.
Engage and influence senior internal/external stakeholders to ensure complete delivery of the RGM transformation roadmap.
Partner up with Channel Heads to deliver counsel and strategic support on the RGM agenda.


Experience / Skills Required


 Degree in Business, Economics or Engineering.
 Excellent written and verbal communication skills, advanced English (90%), Microsoft Office and Power BI.
 Revenue Management / Commercial and Strategy experience in CPG companies (+6 years).
 P&L and broader financial understanding.
 Proven strategic, planning, analytical and negotiation skills.
 Able to influence the business around a clear goal and engage key stakeholders at all levels.
 A driven self-starter, obsessed with winning and executing brilliantly.
 Ability to prioritize and work under pressure with a sense of urgency


Flexibility is key to our success. Talk to us about what flexibility means to you, so that you’re supported to manage your wellbeing and balance your priorities from day one.

Our purpose is crafting iconic drinks chosen for life’s moments. And it’s our people, with their different experiences, perspectives and talents, who make that possible.

We value diversity in its broadest sense and want everyone to feel they can belong, contribute and strive for their personal best. You’ll work alongside people with different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives — challenging, supporting and learning from one another as one outstanding team.

Together, we’re constantly learning and improving, combining the strength of our people, capabilities and iconic brands to raise the bar, grow and win. Wherever you join us, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute, make an impact and play your part in making life’s moments mean a little more.

About Birdman



At Birdman, we're on a mission to make plant-based nutrition more accessible and inspire people to embrace a healthier, more sustainable lifestyle.

We're a fast-growing company driven by innovation, collaboration, and a passion for challenging the status quo.

As we continue expanding our product portfolio and exploring new markets, we're preparing to open our new corporate offices in Mexico City, marking an exciting new chapter in Birdman's growth.

We're looking for a Consumer Insights & Innovation Manager to join our growing team and help turn consumer understanding into meaningful business opportunities.


About the Role



We're looking for a strategic, analytical, and results-driven professional who can connect consumer insights, market intelligence, and innovation to accelerate business growth.

In this role, you'll lead our consumer insights agenda and manage the end-to-end innovation pipeline, from identifying market opportunities and building business cases to coordinating cross-functional teams and ensuring successful product launches.

You'll work closely with Marketing, R&D, Finance, Supply Chain, and Commercial teams to turn data into actionable strategies and bring new ideas to market.

This is an opportunity to shape Birdman's innovation strategy, influence key business decisions, and drive impactful growth initiatives

Build Business Cases: Evaluate new product and market opportunities through financial analysis, market sizing, profitability, and growth potential
Coordinate Cross-Functional Teams: Partner with R&D, Marketing, Finance, Supply Chain, and Commercial teams to deliver innovation projects on time
Evaluate Innovation Performance: Monitor time-to-market, product launch performance, and key innovation KPIs to identify improvement opportunities
Support Market Expansion: Analyze opportunities for geographic expansion and contribute to go-to-market strategies


Requirements

What We're Looking For


6+ years of experience in Consumer Insights, Market Research, or related functions within CPG/FMCG or leading market research companies
4+ years of experience in Innovation Management, including proven expertise leading stage-gate processes and product innovation pipelines
Strong experience in cross-functional project management (PMO), coordinating multiple stakeholders and complex initiatives
Proven ability to develop business cases, including P&L analysis, market sizing, ROI, pricing, and financial projections
Solid understanding of qualitative and quantitative research methodologies, consumer behavior, and market measurement
Experience translating consumer insights into strategic recommendations and measurable business results
Strong analytical thinking, business acumen, and ability to influence decisions across different organizational levels
Advanced English proficiency (C1), with strong verbal and written communication skills
Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Economics, Statistics, Engineering, or a related field

Experience in food, beverages, nutrition, supplements, or pharmaceutical industries
Experience with brand tracking, concept testing, and market sizing
Knowledge of Power BI, Tableau, social listening, or advanced data analytics
Experience supporting international market expansion and go-to-market strategies
Master's degree, MBA, or certification

Ownership: Take full responsibility for innovation projects, timelines, and business outcomes
High Agency: Anticipate challenges, remove obstacles, and drive progress without waiting for direction
Big Thinking & High Standards: Identify opportunities beyond immediate business needs and challenge conventional approaches
Analytical Rigor: Make objective, evidence-based decisions and confidently challenge assumptions

At Birdman, innovation is at the heart of how we grow.

You'll have the opportunity to influence the future of our product portfolio, shape consumer-driven strategies, and lead initiatives that directly impact our business.

Working closely with marketing leadership and cross-functional teams, you'll play a key role in building a stronger, more disciplined innovation process while helping Birdman explore new opportunities and markets.

We're looking for someone who brings curiosity, strategic thinking, and the determination to turn great ideas into real business impact.

Ready to take flight? 🚀

description:
Description

The Amazon Mexico team is looking for a talented, smart, and entrepreneurial Sr Product Manager to help us lead highly complex, high-impact initiatives that shape how millions of customers receive and return their orders.

This is a high-visibility role with leadership-level exposure. You will define and deliver products that require deep technical acumen, customer obsession, data analytics, strong business judgment, and an ability to work across a broad range of stakeholders including WW and Local program management, product management, business intelligence engineering, software engineering, category, legal, operations, taxes, machine learning, supply chain, and finance teams.

We are looking for a leader with super-powers in customer experience, analytics, and getting things done (a not-that-frequent combination!). S/he should be a self-starter that thrives in ambiguity, with the ability to influence multi-functionally, and the willingness to roll up sleeves to execute in a dynamic environment.

As a Returns Experience Sr Product Manager you will lead channel-agnostic initiatives to solve for customer experience pain-points across their post-purchase and returns journey in Mexico.

Your initiatives will shape strategy, drive customer satisfaction, and drive business growth and profitability across one of Amazon's most critical areas.

The role focuses on identifying opportunities and gaps in our post-purchase & returns experience which may include opportunities in our concessions & returns policies, returns resolutions, product lifecycle support (PLS), catalog and fulfillment, channel parity gaps, operating procedures, product/program's logic, etc. While designing, developing and executing a comprehensive master plan with strategic initiatives to improve the way we serve our customers.

A successful candidate will develop a strong understanding of our business, customers and implement data-driven solutions with direct impact in customers and Amazon's growth.

Key job responsibilities

Strategic Solutions Development And Launch

Drive customer-centric innovation, using data to deeply understand pain points and craft scalable solutions. You follow Amazon product development best practices and work backwards to identify gaps and defects in customers shopping and post-purchase journey. You make use of business & customer research and quantitative analysis. You identify emerging use cases and clarify how they differ from existing solutions. You are data-driven and understand the risk of action. You understand a broad range of analytics techniques and know when to use them.

Program And Product Management

Own the end-to-end product strategy, roadmap, and execution for key components of the Product Lifecycle Support (PLS) and Returns Experience (RCX).

Owning the end-to-end launch of programs, features and initiatives to improve the Product Lifecycle Support (PLS) and Returns Experience (RCX) and manage product portfolio once launched. Align product vision with long-term business goals and influence cross-functional teams to deliver on that vision. Standardize processes across different business units, channels, and align recommended processes with stakeholders.

Continuous Improvement

Own Returns experience and Product lifecycle support (PLS) at a process level. Define and monitor metrics, perform root cause analysis on defects and implement remediation; own continuous improvement strategy. Function as a main point of contact for escalations, coordinating multi-functionally to provide advice, implement solutions, and monitor resolutions.

About The Team

Inclusive team culture

At Amazon we embrace our differences and we are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. We host annual and ongoing learning experiences. Amazon’s culture of inclusion is reinforced within our 14 Leadership Principles, which remind team members to seek diverse perspectives, learn and be curious, and earn trust.

Work Life Balance

We believe striking the right balance between your personal and professional life is critical to life-long happiness and fulfillment. We offer flexibility in working hours and encourage you to find your own balance between your work and personal lives.

Mentorship & Career Growth

Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects based on what will help each team member develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic Qualifications


 5+ years of product or program management, product marketing, business development or technology experience
 Bachelor's degree or equivalent
 Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
 Experience with end to end product delivery
 Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
 Experience as a product manager or owner
 Experience owning technology products
 Speak, write, and read fluently in English, and have the ability to take direction in English
 +3 YOE managing technical products or online services
 +3 YOE in product, program, or project management in leading cross-functional teams in delivery of major new products or services


Preferred Qualifications


 Experience in influencing senior leadership through data driven insights
 Experience working across functional teams and senior stakeholders

title: Guest Experience Manager
skills: Supervisar las actividades diurnas y nocturnas del equipo de Guest Experience, asegurando que se desarrollen conforme a los estándares de la Dirección General, del Director/a de Guest Experience y de la marca.
Gestionar la voz del cliente: consolidar y analizar encuestas, NPS, reseñas y comentarios para identificar tendencias, puntos de fricción y oportunidades de mejora.
Liderar el proceso de recuperación de servicio (service recovery), asegurando respuesta ágil a incidencias, compensaciones adecuadas y seguimiento hasta el cierre con el huésped.
Gestionar y promover el programa de fidelización de la marca en el hotel, impulsando el reconocimiento, los beneficios y la captación de socios.
Coordinar la atención personalizada a clientes de programas premium y a huéspedes VIP, en colaboración con el resto de las áreas, sin asumir la atención directa que corresponde a ese equipo.
Definir y supervisar los protocolos de personalización y detalles de bienvenida (ocasiones especiales, aniversarios, lunas de miel) propios de un resort de lujo para adultos.
Actuar como punto de coordinación entre Habitaciones, A&B, Spa y Recepción para garantizar la coherencia de la experiencia en todos los puntos de contacto.
Colaborar con el área de Calidad aportando la perspectiva del cliente, sin solaparse con la definición de estándares ni con las auditorías, que son responsabilidad de Calidad.
Capacitar y sensibilizar a los equipos de cara al huésped en cultura de servicio, hospitalidad de lujo y manejo de momentos de la verdad.
Mantener una relación cercana con huéspedes durante la estancia, recopilando feedback en tiempo real para anticipar necesidades y corregir desviaciones antes del check-out.

Impulsar día a día la venta de experiencias, upgrades y paquetes premium, dar seguimiento a las metas de conversión, capacitar al equipo en venta consultiva y reportar semanalmente el desempeño a la Dirección.

Administrar el inventario, el mantenimiento preventivo y la actualización del equipo audiovisual y de pantallas digitales del hotel, coordinando con soporte técnico, en conjunto con el Director/a del área.

Elaborar y distribuir el calendario semanal/mensual de actividades y espectáculos a las demás áreas (Recepción, A&B, Marketing, Concierge) para asegurar su correcta difusión e integración con la operación del hotel.
Supervisar la generación de contenido audiovisual (fotos/video) de las actividades y espectáculos para redes sociales y materiales de marketing, en coordinación con el equipo de Marketing.
Establecer y supervisar los protocolos de seguridad en actividades deportivas, acuáticas y de alto riesgo del programa de actividades y espectáculos.
